Refactored the remaining boilerplate out of the codebase by turning [ModularExponentiationInput.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/050_modular_exponentiation/ModularExponentiationInput.java:1) into a validated `record`.
